questions.answer: You had to have 5 courses so it was difficult to make the puzzle come together, but the registration process was easy - you just did it online at the university webpage and you could just re register if you wanted another course

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: The teachers were always late even to exams - not easy to adjust to, but otherwise i liked the culture and adjusted to it

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: The teachers were always late even to exams - not easy to adjust to, but otherwise i liked the culture and adjusted to it

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: Enjoying life and going out to dinner, drinks and so on, very social

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Do it for the experience and to experience another culture and city, not for the academic outcome, because the academic level is not like at UCPH. Remember to see anything outside Milan
